name: POST /api/leadflow/events/rebuild - recompute the projection from the log
description:
Discards the pipeline projection and folds it again from the event log, from sequence zero (AC3).

THE ONLY HONEST FIX FOR A PROJECTION BUG. Hand-patching a derived table leaves it agreeing with nothing - not the log it came from, not the next rebuild - and the patch is invisible to everyone who comes later. Recomputing from what actually happened is reproducible and self-documenting.

SAFE BECAUSE THE FOLD IS PURE. apply(state, event) reaches for no clock, no database and no randomness, so replaying the same events in the same order gives byte-identical output. That property is what makes this endpoint a repair tool rather than a second way to corrupt the data.

The checkpoint is marked `rebuilding` for the duration, so a restart part-way through does not present a half-built projection as current. Unverified events are skipped on a rebuild exactly as they are on the live path - a delivery whose signature failed is evidence that something tried to reach us, never a fact about a lead.

200 rather than 202: the rebuild completes before answering, so the caller can read the result rather than poll for it. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: Rebuilds and reports what it applied
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer. Verified against the running server rather than assumed.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify. Distinct from UNAUTHENTICATED because the caller's fix differs: attach a token versus refresh one.
